verdict.rationale: Gitleaks supports a TOML-based configuration format for writing custom secret-detection rules (including composite/primary+required rules), and this config can be centralized via GITLEAKS_CONFIG or a repo-root gitleaks.toml for reuse—but it's scoped to secret-pattern detection rather than general static-analysis, and no evidence shows a mechanism for centrally sharing/syncing rule sets across many repos beyond copying a config file.
